title: 1 Bit Survivor
description:
1 Bit Survivor is an easy to play but difficult to master randomly generated rogue-like with stylized pixel art and survival horror elements.

• Simple controls: Move and Shoot

• Survival Horror: Limited resources make every decision matter

• Turn-Based: Take your time and make your choices carefully

• Rogue-like: Only one chance to survive, if you die it is Game Over

• Upgrade your character with randomized Items

• Choose your play style with three Unlockable Classes

• Compete for the fastest time in the Online Leaderboards

The world has been lost to a deadly virus, transforming the citizens into flesh eating mutants. 

In 28 Days the military plans to nuke everything above ground in a last ditch effort to gain control. Unfortunately for you, the nearest bunker is very far away.

Will you fight your way to safety, or succumb to the Zed-pocalypse?
description_short: 1 Bit Survivor is a unique blend of turn-based combat and survival horror! Carefully manage your resources to solve procedurally generated combat puzzles. Survive 28 Days and save your Pet Cat from the Zed-pocalpyse!
